# Scribd

> > Scribd is a digital library and knowledge-sharing platform hosting 300M+ documents across education, business, languages, and sciences.

Scribd serves as a comprehensive document repository and subscription service where users can upload, discover, and share PDFs and documents across multiple disciplines. The platform specializes in educational content, language learning materials, business resources, and academic research.

## Key Topics

- Document Library
- PDF Documents
- Language Learning
- Educational Resources
- Study Guides
- Business Analytics
- Human Resources
- Teaching Methods
- Knowledge Sharing
- Digital Publishing
- Content Platform
- Subscription Service
- ESL
- SAT Prep
- Academic Research

## Core Platform

- [Scribd: Home to the world's documents](https://www.scribd.com): Scribd homepage: 300M+ documents, knowledge sharing platform
- [Upload a Document](https://www.scribd.com/upload-document): Document upload interface for Scribd contributors

## Education & Study Resources

- [Study Aids & Test Prep Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep): Exam prep and study guides for college entrance and tests
- [College Entrance Exams Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/College-Entrance-Exams): SAT prep materials, sample tests, study guides
- [Book Notes Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/Book-Notes): Literature summaries and book notes for exam preparation
- [Teaching Methods & Materials Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Teaching-Methods-Materials): Educational teaching methods and classroom strategy materials
- [Early Childhood Education Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Teaching-Methods-Materials/Early-Childhood-Education): Early childhood education resources and teaching methods
- [Education Philosophy & Theory Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Teaching-Methods-Materials/Education-Philosophy-Theory): Education philosophy and theory including Stoicism, Utilitarianism

## Language Learning

- [Foreign Language Studies Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Foreign-Language-Studies): Foreign language learning resources: French, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic
- [Chinese Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Foreign-Language-Studies/Chinese): Chinese language documents: Mandarin, Cantonese learning materials
- [ESL Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Foreign-Language-Studies/ESL): ESL English learning documents, textbooks, study guides

## Science & Mathematics

- [Science & Mathematics Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics): Science and mathematics learning materials and resources
- [Astronomy & Space Sciences Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Astronomy-Space-Sciences): Astronomy documents: planets, constellations, black holes research
- [Biology Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Biology): Biology research documents and life sciences resources

## Business & Professional Development

- [Business Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Business): Business analytics, HR, and professional development documents
- [Business Analytics Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Business/Business-Analytics): Business analytics, data science, machine learning resources
- [Human Resources & Personnel Management Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Business/Human-Resources-Personnel-Management): HR templates, handbooks, personnel management documents
- [Career & Growth Documents & PDFs](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Career-Growth): Career development, job search, leadership skills resources
